levels.name: Permissive
levels.description: Threats (phishing, malware, command-and-control servers) and Watchpost base rules: main Google and Samsung telemetry and Google ad networks blocked, essential exceptions guaranteed. No general advertising list: everything works.

levels.name: Balanced
levels.description: Adds HaGeZi Multi PRO (advertising, tracking, telemetry) and the Samsung native trackers. Play Services, Play Store, push notifications and banking apps keep working.

levels.name: Strict
levels.description: HaGeZi Multi PRO++ (more aggressive) instead of PRO, and strict Watchpost blocks: Firebase Remote Config, Galaxy Store, Samsung push and cloud. The essential exceptions stay guaranteed, but some Samsung apps and features may misbehave.
